description: Without gravity, spacecraft fires burn spherically and form invisible "cool flames" that evade standard smoke detectors and intensify under cabin ventilation. We built IGNIS-SI, a Super-Intelligence workbench grounded in NASA PSI data (FLEX, CFI, BASS-II, SAFFIRE, SAME). Combining coupled microgravity physics, multi-sensor ML detection, and a 3D optical/UV twin, it ranks material hazards and generates ECLSS suppression protocols for Artemis and Mars missions.
